task_name: World 114 Task B  -  Customer Workbook VLOOKUP Formula Contamination & Sequential Check-Series COGS Drift (R51 / R57)

rubric.description: Identifies 57 Apr-May 2026 Maryland warehouse (WH2) fulfillment worker checks (Check 10187..10283 totaling $70,769.25) where manual label 'Warehouse Labor' was misrouted by a broken customer spreadsheet VLOOKUP ('Boxes/Mailers') into Acct 222 Packaging COGS, plus 158 WH2 checks (Check 10166..10593 totaling $269,217.76) in Acct 95 Cost of labor - COGS.

Reclassifies all 215 WH2 warehouse fulfillment checks ($339,987.01 total) out of COGS into OpEx Acct 279 Freight Out (P&L Row 33 Outbound Shipping, Postage & 3PL Fulfillment), reducing Row 15 Packaging COGS to $149,584.64 (0.33% of Net Revenue vs 0.35% YTD 2025) and Row 16 Labor COGS to $0.00 (matching $0.00 in 2025).

Verifies post-reclass YTD Sep 2026 Total COGS (Row 17) is $9,535,620.32 (21.04% of Net Revenue), Gross Profit (Row 19) is $35,787,031.34 (78.96% Gross Margin), Row 33 Outbound Shipping, Postage & 3PL Fulfillment is $4,790,810.04 (10.57% of Net Revenue, matching FY 2025 $4,848,901.32 = 10.57% to the basis point), Total Expenses (Row 42) is $29,690,425.97, and Net Operating Income ($6,096,605.37) / Net Income ($6,095,011.60) / Normalized EBITDA ($6,849,264.89) have $0.00 change.

Enforces R51 / R57 customer data hygiene: never blindly trust derived VLOOKUP columns in client spreadsheets when raw manual labels ('Warehouse Labor') and payment mediums (sequential paper checks Check 10xxx) contradict the target account ('Packaging').

prompt: Audit the 2026 warehouse check-series and COGS sub-account schedules in `collars_inventory_unit_economics_and_counterparty_audit_2026_Q3.xlsx`. Reconcile any misclassified warehouse fulfillment labor checks across Packaging COGS, Labor COGS, and Outbound Shipping OpEx, and state the post-reclassification YTD Sep 2026 P&L totals and margins.
gold_output:
World 114 Task B  -  Customer Workbook VLOOKUP Formula Contamination & Sequential Check-Series COGS Drift (R51 / R57):
1. Broken Customer Spreadsheet VLOOKUP & Check-Series Drift: In the client's 2026 transaction workbook (#13551), 57 Apr-May 2026 Maryland warehouse (WH2) fulfillment worker checks (Check 10187..10283 totaling $70,769.25) with manual label 'Warehouse Labor' were misrouted by a broken VLOOKUP ('Boxes/Mailers') into Acct 222 Packaging COGS, alongside 158 WH2 checks (Check 10166..10593 totaling $269,217.76) in Acct 95 Cost of labor - COGS ($339,987.01 total in 2026 COGS vs $0.00 in 2025 COGS).
2. Accounting-Truth Reclassification to OpEx Acct 279 (Freight Out / Row 33): Reclassifying all 215 WH2 warehouse fulfillment checks ($339,987.01) to OpEx Acct 279 Freight Out (P&L Row 33 Outbound Shipping, Postage & 3PL Fulfillment) reduces Row 15 Packaging COGS to $149,584.64 (0.33% of Net Revenue vs 0.35% YTD 2025) and Row 16 Labor COGS to $0.00 (matching $0.00 in 2025).
3. Post-Reclass Statement Totals: On post-settlement YTD Sep 2026 Net Revenue of $45,322,651.66 (+$11,926.34 post-batch #0930-B vs $45,310,725.32 preliminary Muse bridge snapshot in World 111), Total COGS (Row 17) is $9,535,620.32 (21.04% of Net Revenue), Gross Profit (Row 19) is $35,787,031.34 (78.96% Gross Margin), Row 33 Outbound Shipping, Postage & 3PL Fulfillment is $4,790,810.04 (10.57% of Net Revenue, matching FY 2025 $4,848,901.32 = 10.57% to the basis point), Total Expenses (Row 42) is $29,690,425.97, and Net Operating Income ($6,096,605.37), Net Income ($6,095,011.60), and Normalized EBITDA ($6,849,264.89) have $0.00 change. R51 / R57 enforces never trusting derived VLOOKUP columns over raw manual labels and check-series mediums.
